    Lemma 8.8 with one zero relation #

    lem:dimension-infinity with F = d_p d_r for a single zero relation p → m → r of length two in a poset with unique paths: the linearization of the bound incidence table (RaySys.incZ, zero set {(x, z) | x ≤ p, r ≤ z}) is representation-infinite when ∑ d_v² + d_p d_r ≤ ∑_{x → y} d_x d_y and d ≠ 0. This is the form needed for Case 2 of Lemma 8.11 (local-ray-geometry.tex, N = 22, D = 21, F = 1).

    The module of a point of the zero set is a module over the bound algebra, through the matrix units of the incidence algebra; isomorphisms of such modules are conjugations (conj_of_iso), and OrbitDim.orbits_not_finite applies with the F entries of the composite along the relation.
